messages:
nina (infosec): Heads-up: ops will roll a stricter egress baseline into eu-west-2 at 04:00 UTC. May block a couple legacy bootstrap hosts used by GPU reserved onboarding.

rahul (platform): Which hosts? we can't afford mass warm-pool failures before peak.

nina (infosec): Affected FQDNs: `bootstrap-legacy.rw`, `keystore-legacy.eu`, and telemetry endpoint 18.194.22.0/24. Rule id fw-ew2-2026-09.

matt (infra): Staging repro showed new nodes hitting `keystore: transient tcp timeout` -> fallback to cached grant -> warm-pool fill drops quickly. Snippet: `2026-03-12T12:01:01Z node-7 ERROR keystore handshake timeout`.

sasha (sre): Observed warm-pool occupancy falling from 90% to 45% in staging when that block was active. Cold-start tail worsened. Need a mitigation plan.

rahul (platform): Short-term: request a tightly scoped exception for onboarding CIDR for 24h and canary AZ-by-AZ. We'll provide exact IPs and a rollback plan.

nina (infosec): Compliance will approve a 24h scoped exception if you give: exact hosts/IPs, owner, canary plan, and extended audit retention for those flows.

rahul (platform): I'll open ACL PR with the list and a justification. Link: https://git.redwood/fw-regions/pulls/1301. Proposed allow: `keystore-legacy.eu:443`, `bootstrap-legacy.rw:443`, `18.194.22.0/24` limited to onboarding service accounts.

matt (infra): Canary script: `./ops/onboard --region eu-west-2 --az c --canary 3`. Smoke test: `curl -sSf https://keystore-legacy.eu/health` from a fresh node.

sasha (sre): Rollback triggers: warm-pool fill drop >20% within 10m OR keystore 5xx >1% sustained 5m. PagerDuty hooks set.

audit-bot: Created ticket AUD-2026-420 "Scoped egress exception eu-west-2 for GPU onboarding" assigned to nina, rahul.

nina (infosec): Approved for 24h, retention bumped. Please include a post-mortem and timeline to migrate to proxied keystore path.

rahul (platform): Merging PR now, starting AZ canary in 15m. Will post short updates.

sasha (sre): Watching metrics. Ping me if rollback criteria hit.
